NetHandlerPlayServer.overview: Server-side PLAY handler for one EntityPlayerMP. Validates all C00-C19 client packets on netty thread via PacketThreadUtil. Enforces movement, chat-spam, floating and reach gates; kicks or teleports back on violation.

methods.detail: Sends S00 KeepAlive every 40 ticks; records lastPingTime. Decays chatSpamThresholdCount and itemDropThreshold. Kicks if idle longer than maxPlayerIdleMinutes.
methods.name: update
methods.purpose: Per-tick keepalive, spam decay and idle kick.

methods.detail: Rejects NaN via func_183006_b with kick. Gates: abs>3.0E7 kick Illegal position; delta>100.0 teleport-back; 0.0625 moved-wrongly; 0.03125 float>80 ticks kick. Sleeping/riding branches.
methods.name: processPlayer

methods.detail: Validates ChatAllowedCharacters else kick. Normalizes space. Adds 20 to chatSpamThresholdCount; kick disconnect.spam if >200 and non-op. Delegates / to command manager.
methods.name: processChatMessage
methods.purpose: Broadcasts chat or executes slash command.

methods.detail: Distance gate 36.0 and buildLimit check else ignore. Protected/world-border blocks resync via S23 BlockChange. DROP_ITEM respects spectator; RELEASE_USE_ITEM stops use.
methods.name: processPlayerDigging
methods.purpose: Handles dig, cancel, finish and item drop.

methods.detail: Direction 255 means use held item. Requires hasMoved and distSq<64.0, border/protection checks. Too-high build sends S02 chat. Always resyncs with S23; corrects slot with S2F.
methods.name: processPlayerBlockPlacement

methods.detail: Requires matching windowId and getCanCraft. On mismatch stores uid in field_147372_n, sends S32 accepted=false, locks crafting until C0F confirm. Spectators get full resync.
methods.name: processClickWindow
methods.purpose: Validates container clicks and desync recovery.

methods.detail: Reach 36.0 if visible else 9.0. Kicks on attacking EntityItem/XPOrb/Arrow/self. INTERACT calls interactWith; INTERACT_AT forwards hitVec; ATTACK applies held item.
methods.name: processUseEntity

methods.detail: Only accepts key equal to field_147378_h. Sets ping=(ping*3+delta)/4 using nanoTime ms. No kick; stale keys ignored.
methods.name: processKeepAlive

packet_usage.trigger: Client echoes S00 key for ping
Dig state, drop item, stop use

internal_fields.name: lastPosX/Y/Z + hasMoved
internal_fields.role: Last acked pos for delta and teleport-back

NetHandlerPlayClient.overview: Client-side PLAY handler applying server state to WorldClient. Dispatches S00-S49 to world, GUI, scoreboard and entities via PacketThreadUtil. Replies with C00 keepalive, C03 pos-look ack, C0F confirm and C17 brand.

methods.detail: Builds WorldClient from gametype/dimension/difficulty. Sets maxPlayers, reducedDebug. Sends MC|Brand custom payload and client settings to server.
methods.name: handleJoinGame

methods.detail: Adds relative flags X/Y/Z/Y_ROT/X_ROT to player pos; zeroes motion on absolute axes. Replies C06 PosLook. First receipt sets doneLoadingTerrain and closes download screen.
methods.name: handlePlayerPosLook
methods.purpose: Applies server teleport and acks it.

methods.detail: Scales pos /32.0, yaw/pitch *360/256. Type switch: 10 minecart, 60 arrow, 1 boat, 70 fallingblock. Sets serverPos, entityId, velocity /8000.0 and adds to world.
methods.name: handleSpawnObject

methods.detail: If extractedSize==0 does preChunk unload. Else preChunk load, invalidate region, fillChunk, mark render update. Resets relight unless surface world with full chunk.
methods.name: handleChunkData
methods.purpose: Loads or unloads a chunk column.

methods.detail: Resolves inventoryContainer vs openContainer by windowId. If S32 accepted=false, replies C0F accepted=true to resync. No action on accepted.
methods.name: handleConfirmTransaction

methods.detail: If dimension differs clears doneLoadingTerrain, preserves scoreboard, creates new WorldClient, shows download terrain. Then setDimensionAndSpawnPlayer and game type.
methods.name: handleRespawn

methods.detail: level:// loads local file else checks ServerResourceMode. ENABLED auto-accepts, DISABLED declines, PROMPT shows GuiYesNo. Replies C19 ACCEPTED/DECLINED/SUCCESS/FAIL.
methods.name: handleResourcePack

methods.detail: MC|TrList sets villager recipes if windowId matches. MC|Brand sets clientBrand. MC|BOpen opens written-book GUI. Releases buffer after read.
methods.name: handleCustomPayload

internal_fields.name: doneLoadingTerrain
internal_fields.role: Gate set by first S08, reset on respawn

internal_fields.name: gameController
internal_fields.role: Minecraft instance for GUI and world

internal_fields.name: netManager
internal_fields.role: Channel used for replies and queue

ServerConfigurationManager.overview: Server-wide player roster, bans, whitelist and spawn lifecycle. Creates NetHandlerPlayServer on login, sends join burst, and handles respawn, dimension transfer and logout broadcast.

methods.detail: Loads NBT, sets world. Sends JoinGame, MC|Brand, Difficulty, SpawnPosition, Abilities, HeldChange, scoreboard, S08 location, time/weather, potion effects and riding entity.
methods.name: initializeConnectionToPlayer
methods.purpose: Sends login burst and places player.

methods.detail: Order: profile ban with expiry date, whitelist via canJoin, IP ban, then full when size>=maxPlayers unless bypassesPlayerLimit. Returns reason string or null.
methods.name: allowUserToConnect
methods.purpose: Ban, whitelist, IP and full gates.

methods.detail: Untracks old entity, clones player, reuses NetHandler. Resolves bed spawn; sends S2B(0) if invalid. Lifts out of collision to y<256 then S07 Respawn and S08 location.
methods.name: recreatePlayerEntity

methods.detail: Sends S07 Respawn, removes dangerously, scales coords x8 between 0/-1 clamped to border, places via teleporter, re-adds, resyncs time, inventory and effects.
methods.name: transferPlayerToDimension

methods.detail: Adds to list and uuid map, broadcasts ADD_PLAYER, spawns entity, prepares chunk, then sends newcomer full existing roster via ADD_PLAYER.
methods.name: playerLoggedIn

methods.detail: Triggers leaveGameStat, writes NBT/stats, removes mount and entity, drops from maps, broadcasts REMOVE_PLAYER to remaining players.
methods.name: playerLoggedOut

methods.detail: Sends WorldBorder INITIALIZE, TimeUpdate with doDaylightCycle, and if raining S2B 1/7/8 for rain state, rain and thunder strength.
methods.name: updateTimeAndWeatherForPlayer

packet_usage.trigger: Login burst with entityId and gametype

internal_fields.name: uuidToPlayerMap
internal_fields.role: UUID lookup for dup-login and queries

internal_fields.name: maxPlayers/viewDistance
internal_fields.role: Capacity and chunk radius for PlayerManager

NetHandlerLoginServer.overview: Login-state machine HELLO>KEY>AUTHENTICATING>READY>ACCEPTED. Validates C00 start and C01 encryption, verifies Mojang session off-thread, then hands to ServerConfigurationManager or disconnects.

methods.detail: Requires HELLO state via Validate. Online mode and non-local sends S01 EncryptionRequest with serverId, public key and 4-byte verifyToken; else goes READY_TO_ACCEPT.
methods.name: processLoginStart

methods.detail: Requires KEY state. Compares verifyToken with private-key decrypt; throws Invalid nonce on mismatch. Enables encryption then spawns User Authenticator thread.
methods.name: processEncryptionResponse

methods.detail: READY_TO_ACCEPT calls tryAcceptPlayer. DELAY_ACCEPT waits for duplicate logout then initializes. connectionTimer 600 ticks closes Took too long to log in.
methods.name: update

methods.detail: Offline-mode generates offline UUID. allowUserToConnect non-null closes with reason. Else sends S03 EnableCompression if threshold>=0, then S02 LoginSuccess and creates player.
methods.name: tryAcceptPlayer

methods.detail: Logs info with connection string. Sends S00 Disconnect with text reason then closeChannel. Catches and logs disconnect errors.
methods.name: closeConnection

methods.detail: UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes OfflinePlayer:name with UTF-8. Used for offline servers and singleplayer fallback when auth servers down.
methods.name: getOfflineProfile
